title: Dallas Property Data Profile
eyebrow: Dallas Central Appraisal District · Data export, BPP detail & certified rolls · Tax years 2026–2027
intro: Everything Dallas CAD makes available to us in bulk, from three sources: the DCAD data export (14 related tables, published as the July 23 certified export and as current 2026 and 2027 exports), the business personal property detail file, and the certified appraisal rolls. For each file you get its columns, data types, completeness and value distributions. Column descriptions come from DCAD's TABLES AND FIELD NAMES.xlsx and data dictionary where it has them.
foot: Generated {date}. Files were scanned in full with DuckDB; "Auto-detected on load" is the type DuckDB assigns when it reads the raw file, and distinct counts there are approximate (HyperLogLog). "Data type" is inferred from the values: Code means digits stored as text with leading zeros, so it should stay text. Phone numbers and dates of death are not shown.

r26-REAL_ROLL.label: Real property roll
r26-REAL_ROLL.about: The certified appraisal roll for real property in the fixed-width layout DCAD sends to taxing units: one 3,672-character record per account with values, every exemption amount by taxing unit, ceilings, abatements, prorations and flags.
notes: DCAD ships this as a fixed-width file (REAL_APRL_ROLL_DALLAS_CO_2026.DAT, 3,672 characters per record). It was converted to CSV with etl/bpp_roll_to_csv.py using the positions in Add_Change_File_Format.xls: OCCURS groups are numbered _1…_3, FILLER is dropped, and implied decimals are divided out.

Numeric (NU) fields are zero-filled in the raw file. The conversion strips leading zeros, so 8-digit MMDDYYYY dates load as numbers (1012026 is 01/01/2026) and 0 means no date. Read them as text and pad to 8 digits before parsing.
Columns 27–206 are FILLER in this layout; the owner name and mailing address are at the end of the record (OWNER_NAME, OWNER_ADDRESS_LINE_1…5).
Accounts join to the data export on DCAD_ACCOUNT_NUMBER = ACCOUNT_NUM.

PROPERTY_LOCATION_ZIP_CODE is 0 in every row; take the property ZIP from ACCOUNT_INFO.PROPERTY_ZIPCODE in the data export. Many exemption amount, percent and date fields are also 0 throughout (shown in the column table).

DCAD's relational data product: 14 CSV tables per export that join on ACCOUNT_NUM (and TAX_OBJ_ID for building detail), with ACCOUNT_APPRL_YEAR as the central table. Field descriptions come from TABLES AND FIELD NAMES.xlsx and DCAD Data Dictionary.rtf shipped with each export; state codes from SPTD_CD_XREF.pdf. Each current-2026 file carries a note with its row-level differences from the certified export.
